Prophecy: All Things Gathered Together in Christ
ProphecySummary: Paul says God's purpose is that in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both things in heaven and things on earth.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: the gathering in Christ has begun through the church, but the full gathering of all things in heaven and on earth at the fullness of times is still awaited.
